cover.bottom: FROM MAINE TO VIRGINIA IN ITS PATH

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons nor'easter coastal flooding New Jersey storm waves
photo.prompt: large waves and coastal flooding along a Northeast beach town during a nor'easter

slides.headline: Nor’easter batters the East Coast this weekend
slides.body: Heavy rain, strong winds and coastal flooding are hitting the Northeast, with impacts expected through the weekend.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons nor'easter East Coast storm waves
photo.prompt: heavy rain and wind along an East Coast waterfront during a nor'easter

slides.headline: That puts tens of millions from Maine to Virginia at risk
slides.body: The storm is affecting a corridor from Maine to Virginia with rain, wind and flooding threats.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons United States East Coast map Maine Virginia
photo.prompt: weather map style view of the U.S. East Coast from Maine to Virginia under storm clouds

slides.headline: And New York and New Jersey declared emergencies
slides.body: New York and New Jersey declared states of emergency as officials prepared for flooding and power outages.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New York City rain storm street flooding
photo.prompt: rainy New York City street with wind, puddles and emergency lights in the distance

slides.headline: That includes 8 New Jersey counties bracing for it
slides.body: New Jersey’s emergency order covers 8 counties as coastal communities face flooding along the shore.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Jersey Shore storm surge coastal flooding
photo.prompt: coastal flooding on a New Jersey shore street during a nor'easter

slides.credit: Photo: J. B. Sommers / Public domain

slides.headline: And over 400 flights have been canceled
slides.body: Travel disruptions include more than 400 canceled flights as the storm brings flooding and outages across the Northeast.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons airport departure board canceled flights rain
photo.prompt: airport terminal departure board showing canceled flights during a rainstorm

slides.credit: Photo: Curt Teich & Co., Chicago (publisher / Public domain

slides.headline: So the weekend threat is flooding, outages and wind damage
slides.body: The storm is expected to keep bringing heavy rain, coastal flooding and strong winds into Sunday.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons nor'easter satellite storm Northeast United States
photo.prompt: satellite-style view of a nor'easter spinning off the Northeast coast
